description: Records the acceptance tests create, removed after every run in a shared or pool org by scripts/cleanup-test-data.mjs (PIPE-15). Tests name what they create with the E2E- prefix. A story whose tests create a new kind of record adds it here.

records.where: LastName LIKE 'E2E-%' OR Company LIKE 'E2E-%' OR Company LIKE 'PW20-%'
LastName LIKE 'E2E-%' OR LastName LIKE 'Converted PW20-%'
